# SMAA

Source: https://github.com/iryoku/smaa

Pinned commit: `71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d`

`SMAA.hlsl`, `AreaTex.h`, and `SearchTex.h` are used without algorithmic modification. EvoEngine supplies Vulkan GLSL
entry points and explicit float-target color conversion around the reference implementation.
